title: Question 15
passage:
When must these yard-sale signs come down?
A. At the park entrance. B. By sunset on Sunday. C. The green signs are mine.
passageZh:

A. 在公園入口。 B. 星期日太陽下山前。 C. 綠色的告示牌是我的。
